*...As I think about that, I'm made aware of the fact that there's still a lot I don't know.*
*That is why, if possible, I want to learn more about her.*
*She really is a person who's full of riddles, making me feel at a loss.*
*However, even though she's a handful, she definitely isn't a bad person.*
*I recall her eyes full of anxiety as she revealed to me that she's not human.*
*I recall her gentle eyes as she was reading a picture book to the children.*
*Besides that, she showed me that she's unexpectedly domestic, but got embarrassed and started to lose her composure when I praised her for that...*
*She's a surprisingly normal girl, a very gentle person, and—*
*Above all, she's just lovely.*
*As I remember all her different expressions, my face naturally starts to form a smile.*
Yuuma: Yeah, I guess... I really do love her.
*She's making me naturally smile to the extent that I notice it myself.*
*I'm sure, this feeling that basically renders you powerless to refrain from smiling must be love.*
Yuuma: I want to be closer to her. I want to be by her side.
*I want to support her ― she, who is bearing such a heavy burden on her shoulders.*
*And most importantly, I want to see her smile.*
Yuuma: That's why, I...
*I summon up my spirit and harden my resolve.*

Ann: ......
Eleonora: Hey, Ann.

Eleonora: That's what I want to know. Are you okay?

*I can't even muster the energy to put up a convincing act of contrived mirth.*

*Even if we come to love someone, it is only a matter of time until we lose that person again.*

*—That's the conclusion we've arrived at after having lived many, many years.*

*...I don't know.*

*Elle didn't put anything further into words.*
*The truth is, I don't really understand what she was trying to convey to me, but...*

*I think I'll do my best to smile.*
*After all, there's nothing else that I can do...*
